name: GAC
verdict: GAC (Guangzhou Automobile Group), a Chinese carmaker controlled by the Guangzhou municipal government.

why.text: GAC is controlled by the Guangzhou city government: its state-assets commission is GAC's actual controller, and holds 90% of Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group, which owns 54.02% of GAC. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that China committed serious human rights violations against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind GAC is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: The link (claim gac-group-record): GAC Group's 2025 annual report (HKEX and cninfo editions) names Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group as controlling shareholder with 54.02% and the Guangzhou Municipal SASAC, a department of the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government, as actual controller with 90% of Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group; Nikkei Asia (28 Sep 2026) reports the Guangzhou city government controls about two-thirds of GAC. The chain is gac-group, guangzhou-municipal-government, government-of-china: the Chinese state controls GAC through its city government. The record (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment): the UN OHCHR 2022 Xinjiang assessment and Human Rights Watch (2026). The tier is for a maintainer to set (METHOD.md 'Sponsor tiers': a state with a record that controls the sponsor). Not recorded as claims: Sheffield Hallam's Driving Force report (Oct 2024) lists GAC Group among companies in the Ürümqi Toutunhe automotive zone in the Uyghur Region but makes no forced-labour finding against GAC; Nikkei Asia (28 Sep 2026) reports an agreement of intent for FAW Group, controlled by China's central SASAC, to become GAC's second-largest shareholder.

(skoda-auto.com), and Volkswagen AG's Annual Report 2025 names Škoda Auto a.s. among the companies in which it 'holds direct or indirect interests' (claim skoda-vw-ownership); the same report shows Qatar Holding LLC with 10.4% of subscribed capital and 17.0% of voting rights, the third-largest shareholder (claim qatar-holding-vw-stake); two SEC filings by different issuers establish Qatar Holding LLC as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority (claim qatar-holding-qia-ownership); QIA's own About page names it the sovereign wealth fund of the State of Qatar (claim qia-government-of-qatar-ownership). The record: Amnesty International's Qatar 2025 country entry and HRW's World Report 2026 Qatar chapter, two independent publishers, on continuing migrant-labour abuses under kafala (existing claim qatar-migrant-worker-abuse-2025). Judgement call: Qatar's stake sits in Volkswagen AG two levels above Škoda and is 10.4% — a genuine link, but not control — so 'concern' rather than 'serious' seems right; a maintainer should decide. ORG calls 犀旺 its own brand; its 2025 annual report lists Shanghai Xiwang Beverage Co., Ltd. among the companies controlled by ORG's non-state controlling shareholder, Shanghai Yuanlong (Zhou Yunjie) (claim x1-shanghai-xiwang-yuanlong-control). AJA names James Zhou as ORG Packaging's owner and its board chairman (claim x1-aja-james-zhou-ownership). Missing: the shareholding of the business behind X1 (the joint venture, or Shanghai Xiwang Beverage): whether China Sports Industry Group holds a stake, how much, and whether it has a board seat. Under METHOD.md a state with a record counts if it controls the sponsor, holds 5% or more along the chain, or has a board seat; the tier is for a maintainer once that is sourced.
